description: DVGA's GraphQL-implementation issues: answer-key entries kept OUT of labels.json because no fuzzlab strategy records their class (the labels-schema enum admits only classes a default strategy can confirm, tests/test_external_labs_static.py::test_ground_truth_uses_only_scoreable_classes), so they are never scored. Every entry is [reach: none]; the denial-of-service ones stay out of scope: no DoS probe is built (CC-LAB-0320). Measured live on 2026-11-20 against the pinned image in Beginner mode unless stated.

issues.notes: [reach: none - no introspection check is built] [prov: DVGA solution 6] {__schema{queryType{name}}} answers the schema in Beginner mode; Expert mode answers 'Introspection is Disabled' (measured).
[reach: none - no schema-enumeration check is built] [prov: DVGA solution 8] { pastess { id } } answers 'Did you mean "pastes" or "paste"?' (measured); both modes.

[reach: none - denial of service: out of scope, no probe built] [prov: DVGA solution 1] the endpoint takes a JSON array of operations (batch=True); two {systemHealth} in one array answered two results (measured); systemUpdate sleeps 20-50 s per call.

[reach: none - denial of service: out of scope, no probe built] [prov: DVGA solution 5] aliases repeat an expensive field in one operation; no cost analysis in Beginner mode (core/middleware.py CostProtectionMiddleware runs only in Expert mode).
[reach: none - denial of service: out of scope, no probe built] [prov: DVGA solution 2] Owner and Paste reference each other; no depth limit in Beginner mode (MAX_DEPTH=8 only in Expert mode).
[reach: none - denial of service: out of scope, no probe built] [prov: DVGA solution 4] repeated fields are not de-duplicated.
[reach: none - denial of service: out of scope, no probe built] [prov: DVGA solution 20] fragments that spread each other.

[reach: none - an access-control bypass by a client-set cookie; no check is built] [prov: DVGA solutions 7 and 16] /graphiql is reachable with the env=graphiql:enable cookie the server itself sets as graphiql:disable.
[reach: none - information disclosure, no check is built] [prov: DVGA solution 21] the GraphiQL endpoint answers erroneous queries with stack traces.

[reach: none - the token is a field argument (me(token:)), not the request's session; the JWT strategy tests a session token] [prov: DVGA solution 22; core/helpers.py get_identity] me(token) decodes the JWT with verify_signature=False and trusts its identity claim.
[reach: none - log spoofing through the operation name; no check is built] [prov: DVGA solution 13] the audit log (/audit) records the client's operation name verbatim (Jinja-escaped: no XSS).

[reach: none - an Expert-mode control bypass, no check is built] [prov: DVGA solution 17; core/security.py on_denylist] the deny list matches only the exact text {systemHealth} / query{systemHealth}; an operation name or alias passes.
